currentCard.prompt: Если вы не уверены, разрешено ли в парке собирать найденные раковины или камни, как поступить?

answers.text: Забрать находку, если она выглядит обычной и лежит свободно.
answers.note: Даже обычный природный объект занимает своё место; некоторые категории находок отдельно защищены законом.

answers.text: Переложить её ближе к тропе, чтобы другие посетители тоже заметили находку.
answers.note: Камни могут служить укрытием организмам и удерживать воду именно там, где лежат.

answers.text: Оставить её на месте и при сомнении уточнить правила у рейнджера.
answers.note: Некоторые находки можно собирать лишь в определённых местах и количествах; это уточняют в правилах парка или у рейнджера.

answers.text: Взять одну, если вокруг много похожих предметов.
answers.note: Даже разрешённый сбор может зависеть от места и количества, а не от того, много ли похожих находок вокруг.

currentCard.explanation: NPS рекомендует оставлять природные предметы на месте, пока правила не проверены: некоторые находки разрешено собирать лишь в отдельных местах и количествах. Если есть сомнение, оставьте предмет и уточните правило у рейнджера.

source.title: I Didn't Know That!: Leave No Trace Principle #4 — Leave What You Find — U.S. National Park Service

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Conditional uncertainty is essential: NPS says some collection may be allowed in specific places and quantities and advises checking rules/asking a ranger; therefore leaving pending clarification is the sole sound option. Four actions express plausible visitor misconceptions, not unrelated park names. However singular feminine pronouns/«одну» do not agree with plural shells-or-stones prompt.

absoluteLevel.ground: Everyday visitor uncertainty about collecting natural objects calls for leaving and checking authoritative local rules; no specialist park-name/legal-statute knowledge required. Alternative actions are plausible mistakes rather than impossible entities. Overall FINAL remains HOLD due language agreement.

taxonomyAndAntiOverlap.ground: Substantive protected-nature visitor conservation: handling found natural objects and collection permission. Waste removal, trail trampling, feeding/distance, exhibit touching, archaeology methodology and scientific-data collection test different objects and relations. No general etiquette-only wrapper or repeated park identity MAIN.

correctNoteExtraFact.mainFact: leave found object and ask ranger when collection permission uncertain
correctNoteExtraFact.extraFact: some gathering is allowed only at particular places and quantities; compendium/ranger gives limits
correctNoteExtraFact.ground: Specific conditional limits go beyond generic uncertainty and key action. Explanation may repeat them without invalidating note.

defects.finding: Whole prompt names plural «найденные раковины или камни», without a singular feminine «находка». Correct option2 says «Оставить её» with no matching antecedent; option1 also says «Переложить её». Option3 «Взять одну» agrees only with a shell, not a stone in the alternative prompt. Option0 introduces its own «находку», but its wording cannot supply an antecedent when prompt is read independently with another option.
defects.requiredResolution: Make each full prompt-plus-option grammatically self-contained and agree with the same stated referent. Reader does not edit source wording or start an ordinary second cycle. Coordinator retains FINAL HOLD0 and chooses the explicitly authorised continuation path.

editorialGround.locator: L15: read question with each option; case/number/gender/form must agree.

defectResolutions.ground: Old prompt supplied both distinctive components of its park-name answer. New conditional visitor-action MAIN has no park-name key or duplicated complete named answer to extract. It tests action when collection permission is unknown; initial name-cueing defect is removed, although a new agreement defect remains.

Old marine/NZ alternatives mismatched a Central Australian national park. New alternatives are all actions toward the same found natural item, each grounded in a plausible visitor misconception: ordinary/free object, relocation for display, or taking only one amid abundance. No geographical/category mismatch remains.

independence: Personally read complete primary NPS article plus relevant secondary context, including collection exceptions. All current6/4 independently judged and both initial defects explicitly resolved. New agreement defect prevents PASS despite factual/source closure; no SOURCE/root/QA PASS inherited.
stop: Sole cycle1 FINAL ends HOLD0; no ordinary cycle2 or reset. At actualCompactions=1 preserve this result and stop for coordinator ACK/decision.
